card.text: M7 is an open star cluster in the Milky Way, about 276 parsecs away.

sources.label: Hunt & Reffert (2023), Improving the open cluster census. II. An all-sky cluster catalogue with Gaia DR3, A&A 673, A114; CDS J/A+A/673/A114, Table 3 (clusters), NGC_6475: dist50, the median of the maximum-likelihood distance, 275.98760826 pc (16th to 84th percentile 276 to 276)
Wikipedia, "Messier 7"
sources.quote: Messier 7 or M7, also designated NGC 6475 and sometimes known as Ptolemy's Cluster, is an open cluster of stars in the constellation of Scorpius.

introduction.text: M7 is drawn as 961 of its member stars, measured by Gaia; each dot sits at its sky position, at the cluster's distance.
